question: In the Curse of Strahd introductory adventure (Death House), what are the possible outcomes when the characters reach the ritual altar in the basement?
expected_answer: Two main outcomes: (1) If the characters sacrifice a creature at the altar, the cult is appeased, Death House harbors no ill will, the mists recede, and the characters can leave freely. (2) If the characters refuse to sacrifice, the shambling mound attacks and the house itself turns hostile — animated furniture and objects attack as the characters try to flee through the now-hostile haunted house. Strahd is satisfied either way.

bm25_simple.answer: Two outcomes: (1) Sacrifice → cult appeased, Strahd aware, chant 'He is the Ancient. He is the Land', free to leave, advance to 3rd level. (2) Refuse → shambling mound (Lorghoth the Decayer) attacks, then house turns hostile: bricked windows, scytheblades (DC 15, 2d10 slashing), poisonous smoke (DC 10, 1d10 poison), rotted walls with rat swarms. Advance to 3rd level either way. Source: Curse of Strahd PDF p.11-12.
